facts.en: Completed a diploma in Communications Administration at Fictional Institute D099 in 2022.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构院校 D099 完成传播行政专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as a help-content assistant at Fictional Support Publisher D099 from 2023-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-02 至 2026-08 在虚构支持出版商 D099 担任帮助内容助理。

facts.en: Maintained help-article review dates and routed service-rule questions to designated editors.
facts.zh: 维护帮助文章审阅日期，并将服务规则问题转交指定编辑。

facts.en: Checked article titles, links and change references before editor-authorized publication.
facts.zh: 在编辑授权发布前检查文章标题、链接及变更引用。

facts.en: With an editor, reviewed a defined set of 60 help articles during 2025-03.
facts.zh: 在 2025-03 与编辑合作复查一组明确的 60 篇帮助文章。

facts.en: The verified final review log records approved text updates to 18 of those 60 articles; the candidate entered edits and the editor approved content.
facts.zh: 经核实的最终审阅记录显示，该批 60 篇文章中有 18 篇获批文本更新；候选人录入编辑，编辑批准内容。

facts.en: An early worksheet listed 24 updates, including 6 duplicate article rows; the editor corrected the count to 18 on 2025-04-07.
facts.zh: 早期工作表列 24 项更新，包含 6 条重复文章行；编辑在 2025-04-07 将计数更正为 18。

facts.en: The 24-update claim is explicitly retired and must not replace the confirmed 18-article result.
facts.zh: 24 项更新说法已明确撤回，不得替代已确认的 18 篇文章成果。

facts.en: Prepared a 2026-01 review-status guide that the editor approved and the team adopted.
facts.zh: 2026-01 准备审阅状态指南，由编辑批准并由团队采纳。

facts.en: Drafted a 2026-05 conversational-help concept; it was not built, released or tested with users.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草对话式帮助构想；未构建、发布或进行用户测试。

facts.en: At the 2025-10 peak, tracked 9 article-review batches; the normal 2026-08 allocation was 4.
facts.zh: 在 2025-10 高峰期跟踪 9 批文章审阅；2026-08 常规分工为 4 批。

facts.en: Completed a 2024-09 writing course using fictional service scenarios, not professional legal or technical certification.
facts.zh: 2024-09 使用虚构服务情景完成写作课程，并非专业法律或技术认证。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Film Notes Circle V099 from 2024-02 to 2024-08 on evenings while employed.
facts.zh: 2024-02 至 2024-08 任职期间，晚间在虚构影评社团 V099 志愿服务。

facts.en: For the circle, proofread screening descriptions provided by organizers; it was separate from paid help-content work.
facts.zh: 为该社团校对组织者提供的放映说明；与有偿帮助内容工作分开。

facts.en: Made a personal booklet of imaginary island names in 2021 unrelated to service documentation.
facts.zh: 2021 年制作个人虚构岛屿名小册子，与服务文档无关。

facts.en: Enjoys sketching tabletop still-life scenes.
facts.zh: 喜爱描绘桌面静物场景。

facts.en: Maintained a source-and-correction log preserving both superseded values and approved replacement values.
facts.zh: 维护来源及更正记录，保留被取代值及获批替代值。

facts.en: Prepared change summaries that identified approved corrections without presenting retired drafts as current facts.
facts.zh: 准备变更摘要，标明获批更正，不将撤回草稿呈现为当前事实。

facts.en: A separate old biography mentions a service-writing award, but no award record or retirement notice clarifies that claim.
